notes: Technical report (not a system card) on Intern-S2-Preview scientific agentic models. No safety, alignment, honesty, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability evaluation section or tables; evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. Covered Intern-S2-Preview (main Intern-S2-Preview-397B) and separate Intern-MemDec-4B memory extension. Skipped capability benchmarks: Biology-Instructions, Mol-Instructions, ProteinBinder-9, MicroVQA, SciReasoner and other scientific/multimodal/agentic/general/time-series tables (SciTS, coding/terminal agentic tasks, MMLU Pro cross-domain profile, etc.). Pretraining chunk size ≤256k tokens is not treated as an inference contextWindow. MoE inferred from training/systems text (MoE router, Gated DeltaNet); report does not give active-parameter count or license. Biology/chemistry appear only as scientific capability domains, not bio_chem safety evals.
